name: Export the usage report as CSV
description: Open the reporting area, navigate to usage, and trigger a CSV export.
setup_instructions: Assume the user is on the admin home screen.
success_criteria: CSV export is triggered and a success banner is visible.
failure_criteria: The agent opens the wrong report.
The agent submits a destructive action instead of exporting.
grader_notes: For a live adapter, confirm the downloaded file name and the success banner.
optional_cleanup_steps: Clear the download tray if needed.

adapter_config.initial_state_summary: Admin dashboard is visible with a left navigation rail containing Reports.
adapter_config.completion_state_summary: Usage report is open and the CSV export confirmation banner is visible.

steps.resulting_state_summary: Reports landing page is visible with tiles for Usage, Errors, and Activity.
Usage report is open with a toolbar containing date range and Export CSV.
A confirmation banner says the CSV export has started and will download shortly.
